nodes.central_focus: Upstream elevation of the bridge structure over the Missisquoi River.
nodes.image_description: An upstream elevation view of the two-span bridge, featuring a green-painted steel thru-truss main span (Span 2) and a steel girder approach span (Span 1, not fully visible). The truss is supported by a concrete abutment with some graffiti on the right and a concrete pier on the left. The river flows below, and the banks are lined with dense trees under a clear sky.

edges.description_of_connection: opposite_of the downstream view of the same span.
overview_of the pier and approach span shown in more detail.
overview_of the abutment shown in more detail.

nodes.central_focus: Damaged section of downstream approach guardrail at Abutment 2.
nodes.image_description: A close-up of a damaged galvanized steel W-beam guardrail on the downstream side approach to Abutment 2. The rail is bent and deformed, suggesting an impact. It is located on a grassy shoulder next to an asphalt surface, with fallen leaves on the ground.

edges.description_of_connection: detail_view_of a component within the broader approach scene.

nodes.central_focus: View of the roadway approaching the bridge at Abutment 2.
nodes.image_description: A view from the roadway looking towards the entrance of the green steel truss bridge at Abutment 2. The two-lane asphalt road curves to the left onto the bridge. A damaged guardrail is visible on the right, and an intact guardrail is on the left. An 'EMERGENCY VEHICLE WEIGHT LIMIT' sign is posted. Trees line the background.

edges.description_of_connection: contains the damaged guardrail shown in detail.
continuation_of the roadway onto the bridge deck.
opposite_of the approach at the other end of the bridge (Abutment 1).

nodes.central_focus: View of the concrete deck from Abutment 2.
nodes.image_description: A perspective view looking down the length of the bridge deck from near Abutment 2. The concrete deck has longitudinal grooving and features a prominent expansion joint in the foreground. Faded double yellow lines run down the center. Strong shadows from the overhead truss structure are cast across the deck.

edges.description_of_connection: overview_of the deck surface where cracking is shown in detail.
opposite_of the view from the other end of the bridge.
continuation_of the bridge deck from the road approach.

nodes.central_focus: Upstream bearing at Abutment 2.
nodes.image_description: An overhead close-up of the green-painted steel bearing assembly on the upstream side of Abutment 2. The bearing supports a riveted connection point of the truss vertical and diagonal members. The assembly is anchored to the concrete abutment seat. The river is visible below. The toes of the inspector's green rubber boots are visible.

edges.description_of_connection: adjacent_to the downstream bearing at the same abutment.
detail_view_of a component supported by the abutment.

nodes.central_focus: Downstream bearing at Abutment 2.
nodes.image_description: An overhead close-up of the green-painted steel bearing assembly on the downstream side of Abutment 2. The fixed steel bearing supports a riveted gusset plate connection. The bearing is anchored with two large bolts to the concrete abutment seat. Some minor debris and cobwebs are present on the bearing assembly.

edges.description_of_connection: adjacent_to the upstream bearing at the same abutment.
detail_view_of a component supported by the abutment.

nodes.central_focus: Expansion joint at Abutment 2.
nodes.image_description: A close-up view of the Vermont-type expansion joint and the adjacent green-painted steel truss members at Abutment 2. The joint trough is visible between the concrete deck and the concrete backwall. A steel drain scupper is also visible. A fallen leaf is on the truss member.

edges.description_of_connection: detail_view_of the expansion joint seen in the deck overview.

nodes.central_focus: Lateral bracing system of the truss from Portal 2.
nodes.image_description: A view looking up at the overhead lateral and sway bracing system of the green steel truss, as seen from the portal at Abutment 2. The bracing consists of riveted lattice-style members forming an X-pattern. The sky is visible through the openings. The tops of trees are visible in the background.

edges.description_of_connection: opposite_of the bracing view from the other portal.
detail_view_of the superstructure above the roadway approach.

nodes.central_focus: Close-up of the lattice-style top chord and portal bracing.
nodes.image_description: A detailed close-up shot of the riveted lattice-style steel members that form the top chord and portal bracing of the truss. The sky is bright white in the background, highlighting the silhouette of the structural steel.

edges.description_of_connection: detail_view_of the construction of the bracing members.
similar_to another detailed view of the portal bracing.

nodes.central_focus: View of the Missisquoi River looking downstream from the bridge.
nodes.image_description: A view from the bridge looking downstream along the Missisquoi River. The river is wide with a gentle current. Both banks are heavily wooded with green deciduous trees. A distant mountain is visible on the horizon under a clear blue sky. A small portion of the green bridge railing is in the foreground.

edges.description_of_connection: opposite_of the upstream view from the bridge.

nodes.central_focus: View of the Missisquoi River looking upstream from the bridge.
nodes.image_description: A view from the bridge looking upstream along the Missisquoi River. The river appears wider and the water shows reflections and shadows. The riverbanks are heavily forested. The shadow of the bridge superstructure is cast on the water surface. A portion of the green bridge railing is in the foreground.

edges.description_of_connection: opposite_of the downstream view from the bridge.

nodes.central_focus: Lateral bracing system of the truss from Portal 1.
nodes.image_description: A view looking up through the overhead lateral and sway bracing of the green steel truss, as seen from the portal at Abutment 1. The complex network of riveted lattice members is set against a clear blue sky and the tops of surrounding trees.

edges.description_of_connection: opposite_of the bracing view from the other portal.
detail_view_of the superstructure above the deck.

nodes.central_focus: Paint scraping on bridge railing and view of unrepaired diagonal member.
nodes.image_description: A view showing a section of the green-painted steel box beam bridge railing where the paint is scraped off, exposing the metal underneath. Below the railing, a concrete drain scupper is visible. In the background, the river and opposite bank are seen. The report notes this shows a diagonal with section loss that was not replaced during rehab.

edges.description_of_connection: opposite_of a repaired diagonal member, showing a contrasting condition.

nodes.central_focus: Typical transverse cracking on the Span 2 concrete deck.

edges.description_of_connection: similar_to the cracking observed on Span 1.

nodes.central_focus: Close-up of the lattice-style portal bracing.

edges.description_of_connection: detail_view_of the construction of the portal bracing.
similar_to another detailed view of the portal bracing.

nodes.central_focus: Typical transverse cracking on the Span 1 concrete deck.

edges.description_of_connection: similar_to the cracking observed on Span 2.

nodes.central_focus: Downstream view of Abutment 1.

nodes.central_focus: Upstream view of Pier 1 and the approach span.

nodes.central_focus: Upstream elevation of Span 2.
nodes.image_description: An upstream elevation view of the green-painted steel thru-truss (Span 2) over the Missisquoi River. The truss is supported by concrete substructures at each end. The river flows in the foreground, and the background is filled with dense green trees.

edges.description_of_connection: similar_to another upstream elevation view.
similar_to another upstream elevation view from a slightly different angle.

nodes.central_focus: Upstream view of Abutment 2.
nodes.image_description: An upstream view of the reinforced concrete Abutment 2. The abutment footing is founded on exposed ledge rock at the river's edge. The abutment supports the end of the green steel truss. The report notes some light efflorescence and hairline cracks on this abutment. The river has a visible current.

edges.description_of_connection: overview_of the abutment shown from underneath.

nodes.central_focus: Upstream elevation of Span 2 from the riverbank.
nodes.image_description: An upstream elevation view of the green steel thru-truss bridge (Span 2) from the riverbank. The bridge spans the Missisquoi River. The near bank is covered in lush green vegetation, and the far bank is lined with trees. The truss is supported by a concrete pier and abutment.

edges.description_of_connection: similar_to another upstream elevation view.

nodes.central_focus: Upstream view of the bottom chord of Span 2.

edges.description_of_connection: opposite_of the downstream view of the bottom chord.

nodes.central_focus: View from under the bridge at Abutment 2.

edges.description_of_connection: detail_view_of the base of the abutment.

edges.description_of_connection: similar_to another underside view.
adjacent_to the abutment it is near.
